title: A perfect triangular dysprosium single-molecule magnet with virtually antiparallel Ising-like anisotropy

material_class.structural_family: equilateral Dy3 triangle with μ3-η2:η2:η2 carbonate and pentagonal-bipyramidal Dy sites

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, Dy(CF3SO3)3 (61 mg, 0.1 mmol), H2Clbbpen (53 mg, 0.1 mmol), tetramethylammonium bicarbonate (16 mg), pyrazine (16 mg) and triethylamine (0.05 mL) in acetonitrile (9 mL) were sealed in a 23 mL Teflon-lined stainless container, heated at 70 °C for 3 days, then cooled to ambient temperature at 10 °C h−1. The mixture was filtered and the filtrate was left at room temperature; colorless block crystals of 1 formed after several days.
synthesis.temperature: 70 °C hydrothermal heating, then ambient cooling at 10 °C h−1 and room-temperature crystallization
synthesis.time: 3 days heating; crystals after several days
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter the reaction mixture; leave the filtrate at room temperature to give colorless block crystals.

properties.summary: Trinuclear Dy SMM with crystallographically enforced equilateral triangle and nearly out-of-plane Ising axes; dipolar coupling gives an antiparallel/frustrated Ising ground state. Room-temperature χMT matches three Dy(III) ions. Dual ac relaxation below 21 K; Orbach/Raman fits give Ueff/kB = 504(25) K (0 Oe) and 577(26) K (1.2 kOe). Hysteresis persists to 6 K with steps near 0 and 0.2 T from ferro/antiferromagnetic state crossing.

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: polycrystalline sample, 1 kOe dc field, room temperature

measurements.name: magnetic hysteresis
measurements.value: open loops up to 6 K; steps at ca. 0 T and 0.2 T
